ValidationRule.description: BRME-6964: The Focus Area of the Foundation Code selected on the Association should match the Association's Focus Area
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK( Foundation_Coding__c )), NOT(ISBLANK( Focus_Area__c )), NOT( ISNULL(Foundation_Coding__r.Level_1__c) ) , Foundation_Coding__r.Level_1__c <> Focus_Area__r.Name )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Foundation Code's Focus Area should match the Focus Area selected on Association
